name: AK Excel Workbook rules
description: Stricter checks before an AppSource submission. Warnings that AppSource validation treats as errors are raised to Error here so they are fixed early.

rules.justification: Only use BEGIN..END for compound statements.
Variable naming by type prefix is not used in this project.
Placeholders in labels need a Comment.
Every new object and field must carry the registered affix.
Every object ID must be inside the registered range.
